comment: Skill router table. First match wins; order = priority. Patterns are case-insensitive regex. Hints are advisory and cost ~40 tokens only on match.

routes.pattern: (ready to push|can i push|safe to push|before (i|we) push|pre[- ]?push|\b(can you|could you|let'?s|please|now|go ahead and|then) push\b|^\s*push (it|this|the (branch|changes|fix|commits?))\b(?! out| on)|^\s*push to (origin|main|master|remote|github)\b|push (it|this|the (branch|changes|fix)) (up )?to (origin|main|master|remote|github))
routes.hint: Run quality checks and auto-fix before any push (max 3 iterations).
Build or refresh the graph with `graphify update .` (AST only, no LLM), or /graphify for docs and images. For a question about the code, run `graphify query` instead of rebuilding.

Repeated failures. Follow systematic-debugging: after three failed fixes it stops and questions the architecture instead of trying a fourth. If the work has a checkable finish line, set /goal with a turn clause. Never start an unattended loop without user confirmation.
Red, green, refactor, then set /goal with a condition the test output proves.

routes.pattern: \b(fix|debug|investigate|diagnose|track down)\b.{0,40}\b(bug|crash|exception|failure|failing|broken|regression)\b|\b(crash(es|ed|ing)?|fails|failed|is not working|is failing|are failing|isn'?t working|is broken|are broken|keeps? (failing|crashing)|throws? an? (error|exception))\b|\b(there'?s|there is|found|have) an? bug\b|\btraceback\b
routes.hint: Root cause before any fix, one hypothesis at a time.
Design and approval first, then writing-plans, then test-first implementation. No code before the human approves the design.
Generate and verify docs until complete (max 5 iterations, 15m).

Run /fullreview. If the product under review is itself agentic (LLM SDK calls, agent loops, MCP, tool schemas, prompt files), fullreview adds domain 11 (twelve-primitive agentic harness review, scored HML 0-5 against the Agent Harness Maturity Specification) automatically.

routes.pattern: (review for over.engineer|what can (we|i) delete|is this over.engineer|simplify review|ponytail.?review|too much abstraction|find (bloat|dead code))
routes.hint: Over-engineering only: finds what to delete, stdlib replacements, YAGNI violations. One line per finding, net LOC saved at end.

routes.pattern: (audit (codebase|for bloat|for over.engineer)|ponytail.?audit|what can (i|we) delete from (repo|codebase)|find bloat in)
routes.hint: Whole-repo complexity scan ranked by cut size. Lists findings only, does not apply them.

routes.pattern: \b(prompt injection|chat endpoint|llm prompt|system prompt (leak|exfil)|untrusted (input|text) (to|into) (the )?(llm|model)|agent tool result)\b
routes.hint: Pick a threat tier (single-user/internal/public) first, then apply the zero-cost baseline: sanitize, regex-flag, canary+delimiter, output validation. Don't add ML scanners/human-approval queues unless the tier calls for it.

routes.pattern: \b(ingest(ion)? pipeline|document ingestion|embed(ding)? documents?|vector store|rag pipeline|knowledge base upload)\b
routes.hint: Scrub at ingest AND re-check at retrieval — poisoned corpus entries fire on someone else's unrelated query later. Reuses prompt-injection-defense's baseline on retrieved chunks.
